model_final_decision.method_summary: V-space projection kernel with 2D-view softmax, Gram-matrix norm computation, and F.scaled_dot_product_attention for the alpha=1.0 fast path. Non-alpha path computes q,k,v via 2D matmul, logits with transposed matmul, p0 and p1 softmaxes, p_mix via lerp, and ratio from Gram-matrix derived norms of p1 and p_mix against x. Raw CPU-time ratio improved from 0.4550 to 0.4535 (~0.3% better) and all 5 seeds pass numerical gates.
model_final_decision.next_direction: Future work could explore size-adaptive projection strategies (e.g. F.linear for larger C), fusing the ratio multiply with the final p_mix@v output, or investigating whether torch.compile (if allowed on CPU) yields further BLAS-level gains on the projection matmuls.
